# whatmodel.sh · find the best speech-to-text models you can run

[llm](../README.md) · [image](image.md) · [video](video.md) · [tts](tts.md) · **stt**

updated 2026-10-07 14:45 UTC · 141 models · scores combine 69 benchmarks · [how it works](method.md) · [benchmark your machine](https://whatmodel.sh/bench) · [interactive version](https://whatmodel.sh/stt)

<details><summary>Extra: filter models and choose a score scale</summary>

[All sets](https://whatmodel.sh/stt) · [Open ASR English short-form WER (March 2026) · 128 models](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?set=open-asr-wer) · [LibriSpeech test-clean WER · 11 models](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?set=librispeech-test-clean-wer%40speech-espnet-librispeech-20260929)

Filtering keeps overall scores. On the site, choose **within selected set** to use only that set’s evaluations. Models without a shared score scale are marked **not yet calibrated**.

</details>

Run `curl "whatmodel.sh/stt?mac=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize)"` to see what your Mac can run, or `curl whatmodel.sh/stt` for this list in your terminal.

<details><summary>Linux, Windows and common machines</summary>

```sh
curl "whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=$(awk '/MemT/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_vram_total 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)"   # Linux
curl.exe "whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=$((gcim Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>$null)"   # Windows
```

[16GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=16&gpu=apple) · [32GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=32&gpu=apple) · [64GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=64&gpu=apple) · [128GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=128&gpu=apple) · [12GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=32&gpu=card&vram=12) · [24GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=64&gpu=card&vram=24) · [16GB, no graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?ram=16&gpu=none)
